exposure: Patients aged < 35 years without medical comorbidity, cesarean delivery, and preterm delivery
Patients aged <= 35 years without medical comorbidity
cohort: This study included 12,857,721 patients from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project's National Inpatient Sample who had vaginal or cesarean deliveries between January 2016 and December 2019.
finding: There was a gradual increase in the number of patients diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder at delivery, and severe maternal morbidity was associated with a higher likelihood of post-traumatic stress disorder diagnosis.
